note: World data for the balloon ride (CN5 / OBJECT-CONTRACT-v1 §7, PLACE-DATA-v1 carrier places). Positions are world metres; a route point is [t seconds from lift-off, x, y, z] of the basket FLOOR centre. The path is a time-parametrised cubic Hermite spline (tangents (p[i+1]-p[i-1])/(t[i+1]-t[i-1]), zero at launch and landing), so every viewer and replay agree for a given departure tick. Basket-local frame: +x = forward (engine yaw 0 faces +x), +z = right; yaw follows travel.

mount.note: two-step wooden block behind the basket; riders step up and in
